title: RDS connection pool exhaustion
steps: Identify recent deploys changing pool size or replica count
Roll back offending deploy or raise pool/connections as stopgap

title: Cache stampede / thundering herd
symptoms: latency spike with flat request rate
steps: Confirm hit-rate drop aligns with latency onset
Check for synchronized key expiry (no TTL jitter)
Add TTL jitter + request coalescing / single-flight

title: Latency regression after deploy
symptoms: p95 step change at deploy boundary
steps: Correlate latency step with deploy timeline
Roll back or restore async/cached path
Add canary latency gate to pipeline
